terra.problem: The line treats the rock of Etam and Rehoboam’s town of Etam as the same place. The verses do not establish this, and Easton’s lists them separately.
The line and first moment’s title say Samson hid from the Philistines. Judges 15:8 says he stayed in the cave but does not state his purpose.
The third moment says Rehoboam strengthened the cities’ walls. The BSB says he strengthened their fortifications, without specifying walls.
The title “Rehoboam fortifies Etam” may be above a fifth-grade reading level. “Rehoboam strengthens Etam” would be simpler.
